description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-filenode-client/tests/integration_get_query.rs with 5 async wiremock integration tests covering FileNode/get, /changes, /query, /queryChanges. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 §3.2.1, §3.2.2, §3.2.5, §3.2.6; RFC 8620 §5.2, §5.5, §5.6.

**Tests:**
1. file_node_get_with_fetch_parents: call with fetch_parents=Some(true); mock returns 2 nodes (the requested file and its parent dir); assert resp.list.len()==2, node names; assert request body has "fetchParents":true. Oracle: §3.2.1 ancestor nodes returned alongside requested nodes.
2. file_node_get_without_fetch_parents_omits_field: call with fetch_parents=None; assert request body does NOT contain fetchParents key. Oracle: §3.2.1 default false.
3. file_node_changes_returns_change_lists: call with since_state="s3"; mock returns created ["n10","n11"], updated ["n5"]; assert fields; assert sinceState == "s3" and no maxChanges in request. Oracle: RFC 8620 §5.2.
4. file_node_query_with_depth_and_filter: call with depth=Some(2), filter {"parentId":"dir1"}; assert resp.ids.len()==3; assert request body contains "depth":2. Oracle: §3.2.5 depth parameter.
5. file_node_query_changes_returns_added_and_removed: assert old/new queryState, removed ["n8"], added[0].id=="n12" and index==2. Oracle: RFC 8620 §5.6.

**Algorithm:** MockServer::start().await, mount Mock for POST /api/, build session with primaryAccounts["urn:ietf:params:jmap:filenode"] = "acc1", construct SessionClient, call method, assert response, capture received_requests and assert request body.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 5 tests pass. No test derives expected values from code.
